Projections before the draft had Burke as a possible late D3 pick.  He was cited as being a tweener who might not be able to play edge, but was a developmental 5-tech in the NFL.  That's a kiss of death, because that position is dying with far less base defense league wide, particularly for teams that are comfortable playing run defense from big nickel.

His standout testing number is a 6.94 3-cone, which was recorded at the Texas pro day.  That number would be the envy of many CBs in this league (who often refuse to test) and is outstanding for an edge rusher.  By comparison:

V Miller 6.70
TJ Watt 6.79
M Green 6.85
JJ Watt 6.88
M Crosby 6.89
J Clowney 7.27
B Chubb: 7:37
Z Smith: 7.42
D Lawrence: 7.46

Caveat:  All of the above were measured at combine.

The Ravens do a good job recruiting priority UDFAs and were lucky to Burke.
